summary: Add VM cluster instances by updating the inventory (one automationcontroller group, optional instance groups) and re-running setup with all original passwords. Resources with no group use automationcontroller; [database] names an external PostgreSQL. Set a private routable_hostname per node for WebSocket output broadcast.
questions: How do I add a node to a controller cluster?
How do I define instance groups in the installer inventory?
Why set routable_hostname for each controller node?
Does selecting an instance group stop jobs running on automationcontroller?
